# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the canonical engineering baseline. For complex changes, follow `docs/DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md`; apply the relevant rules in `docs/SECURITY.md`, `docs/WEB_AND_MOBILE_RULES.md`, and `docs/QUALITY_GATES.md`.

Inspect before editing, reuse existing patterns, keep scope small, test behavior, and review downstream impact. Do not invent test results, claim deployment success without checking it, expose secrets, or make destructive production changes without explicit approval.
